references.text: Jacob sets up a stone as a memorial in Bethel after his dream, and promises to give God a tenth of all he receives.
God commands Jacob to return to Bethel and build an altar there, in response to the vow Jacob made in chapter 28.
Jacob again raises a memorial stone in Bethel and pours out a drink offering and oil on it, fulfilling his vow.
This is a direct continuation of the same narrative: God's command to Jacob to return to Bethel (31:13) meets with Jacob's obedient response and plan to build an altar there (35:3).
